children: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said at a public parliamentary session on September 6 that Iran's recent strikes on U.S. bases were only the beginning, that the U.S. should understand the rules of the game have changed, and that any future action against Iran's interests and security would be met with a faster, fiercer, and more painful response.

title: Iranian Parliament Speaker Says Strikes on U.S. Bases Were Only the Beginning
